meta.triageRationale: Mechanical asset wiring with the design already chosen by the user: two new SVG files in vscode-plugin/media, one icon field on the insrc.delivery.openBoard command in vscode-plugin/package.json, and one panel.iconPath assignment in the createWebviewPanel lambda passed to registerDeliveryBoard in vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts, mirroring the chat panel's existing iconPath at extension.ts:521. No new contract or design choice. Grounding is a text lookup (grep of package.json and extension.ts), which is enough because the answer is where two existing patterns live.

body.focus: Give the Delivery board its own icon: add the chosen light/dark SVG pair (the insrc spiral at 60% opacity behind a curved four-node progress path: two done, one current, one ahead) as vscode-plugin/media/insrc-delivery-icon.svg and insrc-delivery-icon-dark.svg, set it as the icon of the insrc.delivery.openBoard command in package.json, and as the board's editor-tab icon (panel.iconPath) where extension.ts creates the board's webview panel, the same way the chat panel sets its tab icon.
body.summary: Added the Delivery board icon pair (insrc spiral at 60% behind a four-node progress path) as media/insrc-delivery-icon.svg and -dark.svg; it is the insrc.delivery.openBoard command icon and, through registerDeliveryBoard's new tabIcon dep, the board's editor-tab icon. Behaviour-tested over a fake panel; board-icon.test.ts pins the assets and wiring.
